q.t: How many days are there in a week?
q.e: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday — 7 days.

q.t: How many months are there in a year?
q.e: January to December makes 12 months.

q.t: How many days are there in a year (one that is not a leap year)?
q.e: Adding the days of all 12 months gives 365.

q.t: How many minutes are there in one hour?
q.e: The minute hand goes all the way round the clock once in 60 minutes, which is 1 hour.

q.t: Which month comes right after June?
q.e: The order goes … May, June, July, August …

q.t: Which month has fewer than 30 days?
q.e: February has only 28 days (29 in a leap year). The others have 30 or 31.

q.t: What date is 3 days after July 22?
q.e: Count on 3: July 23, 24, 25.

q.t: ‘Half past 8’ is the same as:
q.e: Half of an hour is 30 minutes, so half past 8 is 30 minutes after 8 o’clock.

q.t: ‘Quarter past 8’ is the same as:
q.e: A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes, so 15 minutes after 8 o’clock.

q.t: Hetal starts breakfast at 7:00 and finishes at 7:15. How many minutes did she take?
q.e: From 7:00 to 7:15 the minute hand moves 15 minutes.

q.t: How many days are there in July?
q.e: July is one of the long months with 31 days.

q.t: July 1 is a Monday. What day is July 8?
q.e: July 8 is exactly 7 days (one week) later, so it is the same day: Monday.

q.t: In a July, the first Sunday is July 7. How many Sundays are there in that month?
q.e: Add 7 each time: 7, 14, 21, 28. The next would be 35 — there is no July 35.

q.t: How many minutes are there in half an hour?
q.e: Half of 60 minutes is 30 minutes.

q.t: How many minutes are there in a quarter of an hour?
q.e: 60 minutes shared into 4 equal parts gives 15 each.

q.t: Bincy’s birth date is written 2/5/2015 (day/month/year). When was she born?
q.e: The first number is the day (2) and the second is the month (5th month = May).

q.t: Bincy was born on 2 May 2015. How old will she be on 2 May 2025?
q.e: Each birthday adds one year: 2025 − 2015 = 10.

q.t: A school period of 40 minutes starts at 10:00. When does it end?
q.e: Add 40 minutes to 10:00 and the hour stays 10: 10:40.

q.t: A radish takes about how long to grow?
q.e: Seeds need many days of sun and water — a radish takes a few weeks.

q.t: Knitting a whole sweater by hand takes about:
q.e: A sweater has thousands of stitches, so it takes a long time — Nani took two months.

q.t: A school is closed for 15 days. July 8 is the first holiday. On which July date does the school open again?
q.e: The holidays are July 8 to July 22 (15 days), so it opens on July 23.

q.t: How many weeks are there in a year?
q.e: 52 weeks × 7 days = 364 days, and a year has 365, so 1 day is left over.

q.t: Bincy was born on 2 May 2015. How old will she be on her birthday in 2030?
Bincy was born on 2 May 2015. How many months old was she on 2 August 2015?
q.e: 2 May → 2 June → 2 July → 2 August is 3 months.

q.t: Bincy was born on 2 May 2015. Her birth certificate was made on 18 May 2015. How many days after her birth was that?
q.e: Both dates are in May, so subtract: 18 − 2 = 16.

q.t: Bincy was born on 2 May 2015. When was her eighth birthday?
q.e: Add 8 years to 2015: 2023. Birthdays always fall on the same day and month.

q.t: How many hours are there from 9 o’clock in the morning to 1 o’clock in the afternoon?
q.e: Count the hours: 10, 11, 12, 1 — that is 4 hours.

q.t: At 3 o’clock, where does the minute hand point?
q.e: At any ‘o’clock’ time the minute hand points straight up to 12; the hour hand points to the hour.

q.t: At half past 6, where does the minute hand point?
q.e: Half past means the minute hand has gone half-way round, from 12 down to 6.

q.t: Hetal is twice as old as her brother, and she is also 10 years older than him. How old is Hetal?
q.e: Twice as old means her age is his age + his age. So the extra 10 years is his age: he is 10 and she is 20.

q.t: Today is Wednesday. What day will it be 10 days from today?
q.e: 7 days later is Wednesday again; 3 more days: Thursday, Friday, Saturday.

q.t: 1 March is a Monday. March has 31 days. What day is 1 April?
q.e: 1 April is 31 days later: 4 weeks (28 days) bring us back to Monday, then 3 more days: Thursday.

q.t: A film starts at 4:15 and lasts 2 hours and 30 minutes. When does it end?
q.e: 4:15 + 2 hours = 6:15. Then + 30 minutes = 6:45.

q.t: A mother is 34 years old and her child is 8. How old was the mother when the child was born?
q.e: They both get one year older each year, so the difference stays the same: 34 − 8 = 26.

q.t: Nani was 25 years old when Mother was born. Mother is now 34. How old is Nani now?
q.e: Nani has lived 34 more years since then: 25 + 34 = 59.

q.t: A train leaves at 7:45 and arrives at 9:00. How many minutes is the journey?
q.e: 7:45 to 8:00 is 15 minutes, and 8:00 to 9:00 is 60 more: 75.

q.t: How many days are there in January and February together (not a leap year)?
q.e: January has 31 days and February has 28: 31 + 28 = 59.

q.t: Ravi was born on 15 June 2017. How old is he on 15 June 2026?
q.e: It is his birthday, so count whole years: 2026 − 2017 = 9.

q.t: In a July, the first Thursday is July 4. How many Thursdays are there in that month?
q.e: 4, 11, 18, 25. The next, 32, is past July 31.

q.t: Starting at 6:00, Asha does 25 minutes of homework, 45 minutes of play and 20 minutes of dinner. When does she finish?
q.e: 25 + 45 + 20 = 90 minutes = 1 hour and 30 minutes. 6:00 + 1 hour 30 minutes = 7:30.
